searchText: Wow TIL there's a GraphQL schema?? 🤯 https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis#graphql <@543900561460822016> do you know if any clients besides Besu & Geth have plans around this? i don’t know if any others intend on supporting it (although that’s a driven a bit by demand too) Gotcha. Ya I suppose it raises the question of if it's worth clients investing the resources vs. letting other services like the Graph solve this demand. I'm probably not qualified to speak to the tradeoffs to consider there. I wonder if there's any way to quantify the usage of e.g. Geth's GraphQL servers? https://geth.ethereum.org/docs/rpc/graphql I think Sina would be the best person to talk to <@259648573401071617> <@543900561460822016> I cleaned up my notes from our call: https://notes.ethereum.org/@samajammin/json-rpc-api-docs As you have time over the next couple weeks, please feel free to edit & expand off this (or use your own doc if you like). Would be great to start outline what specific changes you'd like to see to the playground. I tried to capture what you folks mentioned but I may have missed some.
